items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: That's what Kid Thomas told me the other day too.

ctx.x: I'm wondering, change the subject a little, what was the biggest funeral you ever played with more bands, most bands and all? Well, I'll tell you, this Undertaker,

the Murray Henderson, he had five bands. That's what Kid Thomas told me the other day too. Five bands and the next one was old man Allen, he had four bands. I played both of those films. I just had to come into the Urica Band at that time. We had a bass player at that time by the name of Joe Howard. You heard of him? Used to be a trumpet player, but he paralyzed his lip when he went to bass. He paralyzed the nerve of his lip. He was making those high notes all the time, just just paralyzed his lip. He could play…
Well, how long has it been since you've played a funeral with more than one band?
